headline: Pfizer (PFE) Could Be 12% Undervalued Following Raised 2026 Revenue Guidance
summary: Pfizer (PFE) is back in focus after its second quarter 2026 update, which paired a reported net loss and sizeable non cash impairments with higher full year revenue guidance and solid non COVID product performance. See our latest analysis for Pfizer. The latest results and raised revenue guidance have lifted sentiment toward Pfizer, with the stock showing a 1 month share price return of 8.81% and a 1 year total shareholder return of 15.42%, although longer term total shareholder returns...
